name: Net Operating Assets (balance-sheet bloat, Hirshleifer)
construction: PIT asof-join (available_date<=t) from MASTER_fundamentals_pit: NOA_proxy = (fixed assets + cwip + other assets - other liabilities) / total assets. Screener BS format has no cash line item, so 'investments' is treated as the financial-asset leg and excluded from operating assets ([INFERENCE] proxy, label it). Cross-sectional rank per date, sign flipped (high NOA = bad). Horizons 1Y (panel_long) + 5Y.
orthogonality: vs asset-growth (both balance-sheet; NOA is COMPOSITION level, asset-growth is SIZE growth - expect corr 0.3-0.5, kill if >0.6); vs CFO/PAT and tested accruals H022 (NOA is the stock, accruals the flow - expect corr <0.4). Must pass leave-one-out incremental add over the 7-leg base.
money_rationale: Bloated operating balance sheets mean capitalized costs and future write-downs - shorts/underweights self-fund the long book; full-coverage data (49k rows), zero incremental cost.
refinement: If level fails: dNOA (yoy change in NOA_proxy) - the flow version, one child only.

name: CWIP commissioning / capex-cycle inflection
construction: PIT asof-join: commissioning intensity = z_cs(dFA/TA_lag1y) - z_cs(dCWIP/TA_lag1y) where dFA = yoy change in fixed assets, dCWIP = yoy change in cwip, TA_lag = prior-year total assets, z_cs = per-date cross-sectional z. High score = CWIP converting into commissioned fixed assets (capacity coming online, operating leverage ahead). Horizons 1Y + 5Y.
orthogonality: vs asset-growth (CRITICAL: asset-growth says total growth is bad; this says the COMPLETION phase of capex is good - if corr>0.6 the distinction is empty, kill); vs QMJ (op-profitability may already reflect post-commissioning margins - expect corr <0.3); vs MA-65 slope (market may front-run commissioning - check).
money_rationale: India is mid capex-cycle; the operating-leverage turn at commissioning is the firm's own documented microcap-multibagger engine (07_FRAMEWORK_MICROCAP) and nobody screens CWIP systematically.
refinement: If continuous score fails: binary event version - flag = (CWIP/TA fell >2pp yoy) AND (FA grew >10%), event-time evaluation.

name: Tax-rate authenticity (cash-tax realism)
construction: PIT asof-join: eff_tax = median of last 3 FY 'tax %' values, winsorized to [0, 40]. Score = eff_tax, sign +: firms persistently paying near-statutory tax (~25% post-2019, ~30% before) have earnings the taxman agrees are real; near-zero tax with high reported PAT = manufactured earnings. Rank per date. Horizons 1Y + 5Y.
orthogonality: vs CFO/PAT authenticity (same economic FAMILY - earnings realism - but different verifier: taxman vs cash flow; CFO data covers only ~7.6k rows vs tax 48.6k, so overlap sample small; kill if corr>0.6 on the overlap); vs EY (low-tax names may screen cheap - check).
money_rationale: Extends the earnings-authenticity edge (CFO/PAT leg, IC_IR 1.14) from ~15% coverage to the FULL universe using a column nobody uses - coverage is itself alpha (2026-07 lesson).
refinement: If level fails: d(eff_tax) trend - a falling effective rate with rising PAT as a penalty flag.

name: Other-income dependence (earnings composition)
construction: PIT asof-join: OI_share = sum(other income, last 3 FY) / sum(PBT, last 3 FY), winsorized [0, 1.5], NaN where 3y PBT sum <= 0. Sign -: profits made of treasury/one-offs rather than operations fade. Exclude financials sector (other income is core there) via panel_long sector col. Horizon 1Y.
orthogonality: vs QMJ (its profitability leg uses operating profit / assets, so OI_share is partially the complement - expect corr 0.3-0.5, kill if >0.6); vs CFO/PAT (other income is often cash - mechanisms differ).
money_rationale: Core-earnings purity predicts persistence; the market prices headline PAT, we get paid for the composition gap - full coverage, zero data cost.
refinement: If share-level fails: d(OI_share) yoy - rising dependence as a decay signal.

name: Reporting-lag governance signal (filing speed)
construction: From MASTER_fundamentals_pit itself: lag_days = available_date - fiscal-period end (period end reconstructed from fiscal_year/period_label). Signal = -z_cs(median lag_days over last 4 periods) plus a penalty term for d(lag) > +30 days vs own trailing median (lengthening = deteriorating). Companies that report fast and consistently are better governed. Horizon 1Y.
orthogonality: vs QMJ (governance correlates with quality - expect corr 0.2-0.4); vs net-issuance and CFO/PAT (no mechanical link). This is a metadata signal - no leg uses available_date as INFORMATION.
money_rationale: Filing delay is the earliest observable symptom of trouble (auditor friction, number-massaging) and is PIT by construction - the timestamp IS the data; literally free from a file we already own.
refinement: If cross-sectional level fails: event version - lag lengthening >45 days vs own history as a sell/underweight flag only.

name: Debt-issuance anomaly (external financing, debt channel)
construction: PIT asof-join: debt_iss = (borrowings_t - borrowings_{t-1FY}) / total assets_{t-1FY}, winsorized. Sign -: heavy debt raisers underperform (financing anomaly, Bradshaw et al). NOT the killed deleveraging idea (that was distress-REPAIR, level falling); this is the issuance/overexpansion side. Horizons 1Y + 5Y.
orthogonality: vs asset-growth (debt funds assets - expect corr 0.4-0.6, kill/fold if >0.6 - this is the main risk); vs net-share-issuance (different financing channel, expect corr <0.3). Must add leave-one-out increment over the 7-leg base or die.
money_rationale: Completes the financing-anomaly pair with the survivor equity-issuance leg; managers time BOTH markets and debt data has full coverage.
refinement: If standalone fails vs asset-growth overlap: composite external financing = d(borrowings + equity capital)/TA as a single replacement candidate for BOTH balance-sheet legs (leg-count reduction, not addition).

name: Issuance-leg purification (bonus-issue adjustment) - survivor repair, not new alpha
construction: Current net-issuance proxy = %ch equity capital, with disclosed ~8% bonus/split noise. Fix: bonus_flag for FY where d(equity capital) > 0 AND d(reserves) <= -0.8 x d(equity capital) (capitalization of reserves = bonus, not real issuance); set purified_issuance = %ch equity capital with bonus years zeroed. Re-run the exact survivor-leg evaluation once, purified vs current, same harness settings.
orthogonality: n/a - this is measurement-error repair on an existing leg, logged in the ISSUANCE family trials ledger as 1 trial. Adopt only if IC_IR improves; either way stop after one comparison.
money_rationale: Removing known noise from a live leg is the cheapest possible IC gain - no new family, no new multiplicity, direct composite improvement.
refinement: None beyond the single comparison (pre-registered: adopt-if-better, else keep current and close).

name: Amihud illiquidity premium (cost-aware)
construction: ILLIQ = mean over trailing 252 trading days of |daily return| / (close x volume) from cube_close_long x cube_volume (rupee volume), log-transformed, ranked per date. Sign +: illiquid names carry a premium. MANDATORY cost honesty: evaluate net at 2x COST_STANDARDS slippage AND report the long-leg's own ADV capacity; also evaluate within the top-half-liquidity subuniverse (where fills are real).
orthogonality: vs ALL 7 legs - no current leg uses volume at all (structurally orthogonal); main hidden overlap is size (H028, tested candidate): ILLIQ~size corr likely 0.6-0.8, so evaluate size-residualized ILLIQ as the primary construct, raw as descriptive only.
money_rationale: Liquidity is the one priced dimension the model is blind to; even if the long-side premium is cost-eaten, the ranking prices the microcap lens and tells us where our OWN capacity is.
refinement: If Amihud fails (skew/noise): share turnover = rupee volume / mktcap (Datar), low-turnover premium - one child only. CAVEAT: cube_volume is 5yr-only (1,238 days) - no 21yr cross-regime check possible; disclose as UNCONFIRMED-cross-regime like all 1M work.

name: Currency-sensitivity rotation (macro-beta x macro-trend)
construction: beta_fx_i = rolling 36-month OLS beta of monthly stock return (cube_close_long, monthly resample) on d(USDINR) (macro_state). Signal = beta_fx_i x sign(usdinr_chg_3m at t): own the names whose FX exposure is a CURRENT tailwind (exporters when INR weakening, domestics when strengthening). Rank per date. Horizons 1M + 1Y.
orthogonality: vs residual momentum (the FF neutralization does not include an FX factor, but recent FX winners ARE recent winners - expect corr 0.2-0.4, kill if >0.6); vs sector composition (run the concentration check - this must not be a concealed IT/pharma sector bet, sector-neutralize as robustness).
money_rationale: FX pass-through to earnings is slow and public, but the market reprices it lazily - a rotation signal no current leg carries. CAVEAT: macro_state has only 127 monthly rows (~10.5yr) - moderate sample, no 2008 coverage.
refinement: If FX fails: same construct with india10y 3m change (rate-sensitivity rotation) - one child, same family ledger.

name: Long-term reversal (36-60m overreaction, De Bondt-Thaler)
construction: LTrev = cumulative return from t-60m to t-12m (skip the momentum window entirely) from cube_close_long, ranked per date, sign flipped (big 4-year winners fade, big losers mean-revert). Horizons 1Y + 5Y (this is primarily a 5Y-lens candidate where the model is thin).
orthogonality: vs residual momentum 12-1 (non-overlapping windows by construction; expect corr ~0 to -0.2); vs EY (CRITICAL: 5y losers ARE cheap - expect corr 0.3-0.5 with EY; the bar is leave-one-out increment over EY specifically, kill if none); vs MA-65 slope (short window, low overlap).
money_rationale: The 5Y sleeve currently has only value+quality legs; a price-based overreaction leg is the cheapest diversifier for the horizon where fundamentals data is thinnest - price history is our LONGEST asset (21yr).
refinement: If raw fails on EY overlap: EY-residualized LTrev (regress out per-date EY rank) - one child.

name: Listing-age / IPO seasoning
construction: listing_age_m = months since first non-NaN close in cube_close_long (mask names whose first date equals the cube's own start - age unknown, NaN). Signal: flag/penalty for age < 24 months (lockup expiries, post-IPO issuance overhang, information asymmetry decay), continuous log(age) as the score. Sign +.
orthogonality: vs net-issuance (IPO = issuance - expect corr 0.2-0.4 but listing-age covers names BEFORE fundamentals exist at all); vs size (young names are small - check, size-residualize if corr>0.5).
money_rationale: India's IPO boom keeps injecting young names into the N500; a systematic seasoning discount is documented globally and free to compute.
refinement: If linear age fails: pure binary <24m exclusion gate evaluated as a composite-level filter (does excluding young names lift composite IC?).

name: Conditional double-sort: momentum WITHIN quality (sequential gate, not rank-product)
construction: Per date: (1) sort on QMJ, keep top 50%; (2) rank residual momentum 12-1 ONLY within that half; bottom-quality half gets NaN (unscored). Evaluate this quality-gated momentum vs plain residual momentum on (a) full-period IC_IR, (b) high-vol-regime IC (regime_vol=='high' tag), (c) net-of-cost LS. Pre-registered win: high-vol IC improves >= +0.05 AND full-period IC_IR degrades < 10%. Rank-product interactions (H029/H030/H046) were tested and killed - THIS IS SEQUENTIAL CONDITIONING, a different operator: asymmetric, gates the universe instead of blending scores.
orthogonality: vs the composite itself: this is a combination-method trial on TWO existing legs, logged in a new COMBO-METHOD family (1 trial). Directly attacks the momentum leg's documented high-vol fragility (junk-momentum is what crashes).
money_rationale: Momentum crashes are concentrated in junk names; gating by quality is the classic crash-hedge that costs no premium - could unlock fuller momentum sizing in the regime layer.
refinement: If mom|quality fails: cheap-within-improving (EY ranked within positive d(opm) half) - one child, same family.

name: Factor-momentum leg-weighting (dynamic weights vs static rank-average)
construction: Per rebalance date: weight_leg = max(w_floor, trailing 12m mean monthly IC of that leg), normalized across the 7 legs; w_floor = 0.5/7 (never zero a leg). Composite = weighted rank-average, all else identical to canonical build (min_legs=5, same universe). Judged per K-015 discipline: must beat the STATIC equal-weight composite net-of-cost AND on Sharpe - not just IC.
orthogonality: Combination-method family (1 trial). Uses only the legs' own realized ICs (trailing, causal). Distinct from the killed return-blend regime overlay: no regime variable, no score blending - reweighting by each leg's own recent efficacy (Gupta-Kelly factor momentum).
money_rationale: Factor momentum is the one documented meta-anomaly that survives costs at monthly cadence; if legs trend in efficacy, static equal-weight leaves money on the table.
refinement: If IC-weighting fails: value-spread conditioning on the EY leg only (weight EY by its own cross-sectional spread percentile) - one child.

name: LEADING bear-regime classifier for the SIZING layer
construction: Features at month t, all causal: from market_state (249m, 21yr): breadth_pct_above_200dma level + its 3m change (thrust), EY_hist_zscore_expanding, 3m slope of market_vol, ERP_proxy; from macro_state (127m sub-period, secondary model): term_spread_us, us10y_chg_3m, usdinr_chg_3m, gold_vs_equity_1m. Label: bear_next = 1 if NIFTY500 forward 3m return < -5%. Walk-forward expanding logit (min 60m train, refit annually) -> p_bear. USE: momentum-leg weight x (1 - p_bear), QMJ/EY weight x (1 + p_bear), floored at 0; gross exposure scalar min(existing breadth scalar, 1 - p_bear). Pre-registered bar (K-015 law): must beat BOTH the static composite AND the existing trailing-breadth scalar on Sharpe with maxDD no worse - judged as a RISK overlay, never on raw CAGR.
orthogonality: Not a selection factor - lives in the sizing layer where the parked trailing-VIX overlay sat. Novelty = PREDICTIVE features (thrust, curve, FX stress, flight-to-gold) vs the trailing confirmation the parked overlay used. Regime family ledger continues (prior trials counted).
money_rationale: The single highest-value open problem: the breadth scalar already halves maxDD using trailing data - any genuine lead time compounds directly into the momentum leg's crash exposure, the model's biggest documented fragility.
refinement: If the logit overfits (walk-forward AUC < 0.6): fall back to a 2-feature pre-registered RULE - bear-warn = (breadth < 40% AND falling) OR (term_spread_us inverted AND vix rising) - one child.

name: Cap-tier conditional composite (microcap 4th lens)
construction: Split panel_pit per date into PIT mktcap quartiles (from mktcap_log within the eligible cross-section). Compute the CANONICAL 7-leg composite's IC/IC_IR separately per tier (no refit, no new factor). Test: is IC monotonically higher in smaller tiers, and does a tier-weighted allocation (overweight tiers where IC is proven higher, subject to Amihud/W4-08 capacity caps) beat flat allocation net-of-cost at 2x smallcap drag (KNOWLEDGE_BASE #17: smallcap must clear 2.4-4.2pp/yr extra)?
orthogonality: No new factor - an allocation analysis of the existing composite (1 trial, COMPO family ledger). Distinct from tested smallcap-tier EY (that was a factor absorbed by EY at 0.94 corr; this is WHERE-does-the-whole-model-work).
money_rationale: If the edge concentrates in mid/small tiers (typical for rank models), same signal + tier-aware sizing = more money at zero research cost; if it doesn't, we learn our capacity is large - either answer pays.
refinement: If quartiles are noisy: 3 tiers only (large/mid/smallmicro) - one child.

name: Earnings-announcement-month premium (anticipation, NOT drift)
construction: Per symbol, predict next announcement month from its own PIT filing cadence (mode month-of-quarter of prior available_dates). Flag = 1 if an announcement is expected within the forward 1M window. Signal = flag (long expected-announcers). Frazzini-Lamont announcement premium - stocks earn more in announcement months (attention + resolved uncertainty). Horizon 1M only. DISTINCT from PEAD (killed): that was post-surprise drift; this is pre-scheduled anticipation, no surprise variable at all.
orthogonality: vs all 7 legs: calendar-mechanical, zero fundamental/price content - structurally orthogonal. vs killed seasonality leg (that was month-of-year return seasonality; this is firm-specific event timing).
money_rationale: The 1M lens is currently EMPTY (low-conviction sector-momentum only); a mechanical calendar tilt is the cheapest possible 1M leg and needs no new data. CAVEAT: 1M horizon has no 21yr cross-regime check (structural, disclosed).
refinement: If the flat flag fails: interact flag with QMJ rank (quality names into announcements) - one child.
